title: Sweet Tomato and Gnocchi Bake
subtitle: with Spinach and Parmesan
description: Whether you’re full-time vego or part-time only, our varied range of vegetarian dishes really hits the spot. Bursting with veggies, dairy, legumes, grains and nuts, they’re packed with flavour, they’ll fill you up and they’re totally mouth-watering too!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Bring a large saucepan of salted water to the boil for the gnocchi. Grease a 1.5L (6 cup) baking dish. Finely chop the onion. Crush or finely chop the garlic. Finely grate the parmesan.

Make tomato sauce: Melt 20g butter and 2 tsp olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Add the onion, garlic and half the Italian seasoning and cook, stirring, for 5 mins or until soft. Add the tomatoes, 1 tsp sugar and 125ml (½ cup) boiling water and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium-low and cook, pressing the tomatoes to break down, for 15 mins or until thickened.

Cook gnocchi: Meanwhile, preheat the grill to high. Add the gnocchi to the pan of boiling water, stir to separate, then return to the boil and cook for 2 mins or until the gnocchi float to the surface. Drain well.

Add gnocchi to sauce: Add the spinach to the tomato sauce and cook for 1 min or until wilted. Remove the pan from the heat. Add the gnocchi and half the parmesan, season with pepper and stir to combine.

Grill and serve up: Spoon the gnocchi mixture into the baking dish and scatter over the remaining parmesan (see Make it yours). Grill for 5 mins or until golden and bubbling. Divide among bowls and enjoy!
Make it yours: Up the indulgence factor by adding some grated mozzarella or feta along with the parmesan before grilling, if you have some on hand.
